resolved_conflicts.explanation: The inventory gives the tower as probably around 100 feet tall, while its 1952 survey note gives approximately 125 feet. Both are kept in the story and height_m is left blank.

notes_for_editor: One county inventory PDF (Wikimedia Commons; author not named; layout extraction interleaves columns) plus the FFLA list. The inventory date column is blank for Honeymoon; no build year, builder, or removal date found. The 1952 survey note belongs to the Honeymoon row: in the PDF's raw text stream it follows Honeymoon's coordinates and 'USFS Stair' owner/type fields (checked 2026-10-10). A search summary said the Good Harbor/Grand Marais tower moved to this site in 1943; the inventory says that move went to the Eliason site, so it is not used. The 1915 Murphy Hill item belongs to a different tower. A Superior National Forest trail called Honeymoon Bluff is off Clearwater Road; its page mentions no lookout, so it is not linked to the site. Gone, so no visit information.
